item.title: Warm Meals and New Hope: Ward 3 Warming Center gives resources to the community
item.description: While community leaders in Midtown & Northside are tackling homelessness, the Ward 3 Warming Center is helping people find stable housing, relief, and a chance to change their lives for the better

item.title: “When these tips dry up this case goes cold”- Nancy Guthrie kidnapping
item.description: Interest in the case is so high the Sheriff’s Department has been flooded with thousands and thousands of tips. They propel the investigation. But how do detectives decide which tips to check first?
